text:
Lina (People Ops): Heads-up: small process changes for this cycle— please skim. Short thread, managers only for first two replies.

Lina (People Ops): TL;DR: we9re piloting a \"micro-calibration\" format (20-min rapid panels) for stable teams + a 48h appeals window after calibration notes are published.

Tom (eng-manager): 20 mins feels tight. What's expected in prep?

Lina (People Ops): Expect managers to bring 3 score proposals (one slide each) and 1 supporting evidence link. Use the short_prep template in the docs hub.

Jia (eng): Is the appeals window for factual corrections only or can managers appeal score adjustments?

Maya (hr-ops): Appeals are for factual errors and missing context only (no re-scoring requests). If you need re-consideration for patterns, flag for cross-org review.

Rafael (manager): If we miss a micro-panel slot because of fire-drill, what then?

Lina (People Ops): We'll auto-assign your manager to the next available slot that week and notify delegates. If you miss two slots we escalate to your director for a follow-up.

Tom (eng-manager): Can I send my EM in my place?

Lina (People Ops): Yes, delegates allowed. Add delegate name + \"delegate\" in the RSVP form. Only one delegate per manager for micro-panels.

hr-bot: Reminder: RSVP link generated -> https://go.redwood/hr/cycle2026-micro-rsvp. Managers without an RSVP by Apr 8 17:00 will get an automated DM.

Maya (hr-ops): New evidence rules: link to 2 supporting artifacts max (PRs, dashboards, oncall logs). Screenshots accepted. No >10MB uploads.

Jia (eng): Where do we publish calibration notes and decisions?

Lina (People Ops): We publish a consolidated calibration digest (redacted) by Apr 25. Individual manager notes live in the review workspace (access limited to managers + HR).

Tom (eng-manager): Who signs off on promotion recommendations during micro-panels?

Maya (hr-ops): Promotions flagged in micro-panels require a short promotion packet submitted to hr-promo@redwood and will trigger a separate 30-min review within 3 business days.

Rafael (manager): Anything new about scoring rubric?

Lina (People Ops): Minor update: rubric v2.1 clarifies "scope" vs "impact" weighting. Use rubric_v2_1.pdf (link in hub). We'll normalize within panels.

Tom (eng-manager): Ok will prep slide deck with 3 slides per report.

Jia (eng): Quick ask  can we get a calendar view of micro-panel slots? GUI helps.

Lina (People Ops): Yespublishing a shared calendar + ICS feed by EOD tomorrow.

hr-bot: Action items for managers: 1) RSVP by Apr 8, 2) submit micro_prep template by Apr 12, 3) upload artifacts to review workspace by Apr 12.

Lina (People Ops): Final note: appeals window is Apr 26-27. Appeals go to appeals@redwood with a one-paragraph rationale and evidence link. HR will acknowledge within 24h.

Tom (eng-manager): Thanks  appreciate the condensed format if it actually stays 20 mins.

Lina (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Ping me or @Maya if you have access issues or slot conflicts. :calendar::eyes:
